title: Highly Dispersed Ru on Electride [Ca24Al28O64]4+(e−)4 as a Catalyst for Ammonia synthesis
extraction_notes: No experimental ammonia-synthesis catalyst-performance entries are reported in the provided SI pages. The SI contains catalyst preparation details for Ru/CaO, Ru/CaO/HT-C12A7:e−, and Cs-Ru/MgO (SI pages 2–3), plus characterization figures/tables (SI Figures S1–S2 and SI Table S1), but no NH3 synthesis rates, outlet NH3 concentrations, TOFs, or reaction-condition performance data.
